stories.title: Sancties tegen Sierra Leone raken de bevolking, niet 'Bolle Jos'

en.title: Sanctions against Sierra Leone affect the population, not 'Fat Jos'
en.summary: The EU suspended budget support to Sierra Leone, causing the country to lose 18 million euros. The suspension is expected to impact education and food security for the population.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabië zal 'stevig terugslaan' na Houthi-aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: Saudi Arabia will 'strike back hard' after Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Houthi forces struck Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport, prompting international concern about escalation. Saudi Arabia pledges a strong response while fighting continues between Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen.

stories.title: Polen waarschuwt voor ‘uitzonderlijk ernstige’ plannen om premier Tusk om het leven te brengen

en.title: Poland warns of 'exceptionally serious' plans to kill Prime Minister Tusk
en.summary: Polish authorities have warned of exceptionally serious plans targeting Prime Minister Tusk's life.

stories.title: Man in Polen opgepakt voor het plannen van een aanslag op premier Tusk

en.title: Man arrested in Poland for planning attack on Prime Minister Tusk
en.summary: Polish authorities arrested a suspect for preparing an attack on Prime Minister Tusk. The suspect's identity, background, and method remain undisclosed, though Tusk thanked police for swift action.

stories.title: Na aanval op luchthaven Riad dreigen ook de VS zich in de strijd tegen de Houthi’s te mengen – met mogelijk ‘desastreuze gevolgen’ voor de regio

en.title: After attack on Riyadh airport, US threatens to join fight against Houthis – with possible 'disastrous consequences' for the region
en.summary: A Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed twelve people and wounded over three hundred. Crown Prince Mohammed bin-Salman faces a difficult situation, which an expert suggests he created himself.

stories.title: Man die verdacht wordt van plannen aanslag op Poolse premier aangehouden

en.title: Man suspected of planning attack on Polish Prime Minister arrested
en.summary: Polish authorities arrested a man suspected of planning an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk. The threat is being taken extremely seriously.

stories.title: Elf doden en tientallen gewonden bij zwaar busongeluk in Turkije

en.title: Eleven dead and dozens injured in severe bus accident in Turkey
en.summary: A serious accident on a highway in western Turkey killed at least eleven people and wounded at least twenty-seven others, according to Turkish authorities.

en.title: Deaths in bus accident Turkey
en.summary: A serious bus accident in Turkey between Bursa and Izmir killed eleven people and injured twenty-seven. Emergency services responded to the scene where the bus and a wooden cargo truck lay overturned.

stories.title: Westerse leiders veroordelen Houthi-aanval vliegveld Riyad: 'Spiraal van geweld'

en.title: Western leaders condemn Houthi attack on Riyadh airport: 'Spiral of violence'
en.summary: Western leaders expressed support for Saudi Arabia following a Houthi rebel attack on Riyadh airport. Officials including Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen condemned the attack, with EU chief Ursula von der Leyen describing it as a spiral of violence involving Iranian allies.

stories.title: Regenboogvlaggen in Oldebroek dag voor Coming Out Day verdwenen

en.title: Rainbow flags in Oldebroek disappear day before Coming Out Day
en.summary: Multiple rainbow flags were possibly stolen in the Dutch municipality of Oldebroek on Saturday evening, the day before Coming Out Day. The municipality had withdrawn its queer policy this year, but the local Kruiskerk church disagreed and raised the rainbow flag anyway.

stories.title: Meldingen van gestolen regenboogvlaggen in Oldebroek, ook vlag bij Kruiskerk verdwenen

en.title: Reports of stolen rainbow flags in Oldebroek, including flag at Kruiskerk missing
en.summary: Rainbow flags in the Dutch municipality of Oldebroek have been reported missing, including one at the Kruiskerk church.

stories.title: 12 doden en 300 gewonden bij Houthi-aanval op luchthaven in Saoedi-Arabië

en.title: 12 dead and 300 wounded in Houthi attack on airport in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: A Houthi rebel attack on an airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and over 300 injuries when the passenger terminal was struck.
